capability: Products: the store's product catalog (Shopify Products; Salla Products / المنتجات)
note: Parent of CM-CAT-002 to CM-CAT-009: the product record and what both platforms keep on it. Both keep products as one admin section and one API group (M-011).

capability: Product options and variants (Shopify variants; Salla Product Options, Option Values, Variants)
note: Shopify keeps variants inside its products concern; Salla gives options and variants their own API folders, webhooks and plan line.

capability: Product groupings: collections and categories (Shopify Collections; Salla Categories / الأقسام, تصنيفات المنتجات)
note: The store's own groupings of its products. Joined on role: Shopify's collections and Salla's categories (landings, notes).

capability: Standard product taxonomy (Shopify taxonomy linking; Salla google-taxonomy, salla-taxonomy)
note: A standard classification of products, apart from the store's own groupings. Salla keeps it in its categories concern.

capability: Brands (Salla Brands / الماركات التجارية)
note: A product's brand as its own record. Salla only so far.

capability: Product tags (Shopify product tags; Salla Product Tags / وسوم المنتجات)
note: Both keep tags inside their products concerns.

capability: Product media: images, video and 3D (Shopify media; Salla Product Images, media-center)
note: Both keep media inside their products concerns.

capability: Combined listings (Shopify Combined Listings)
note: Separate products shown together as one listing. Shopify only so far.

capability: Product restrictions (Salla Product restrictions / قيود المنتج, sales-restrictions)
note: Salla only so far; its statements don't say what a restriction limits (notes).

capability: Product sourcing: dropshipping, print on demand and wholesale buying (Shopify sourcing apps and Shopify Collective; Salla Drop shipping apps and wholesale market)
note: Where the store gets products from other businesses to sell.

capability: Subscriptions and recurring payments (Shopify subscriptions and selling plans; Salla Recurring Payments / subscriptions)
note: Recurring purchases a store sells to its customers (M-074).

capability: Digital products (Shopify digital goods; Salla Digitals Product, digital codes and files)
note: Products delivered as files or codes (M-076). Parent of CM-SEL-003.

capability: NFTs and token-gating (Shopify Blockchain, nft-application)
note: Shopify only so far; Shopify keeps it with digital goods.

capability: Bookings and reservations (Salla Bookings, Order Reservations / الحجوزات)
note: A product the buyer books for a time. Salla only so far.

capability: Pre-orders (Salla Pre-order campaigns / حملات الطلب المسبق)
note: Selling a product before it is in stock. Salla only so far.

capability: Product bundles (Shopify bundles; Salla bundle products)
note: Several products sold as one.

capability: Donations (Shopify Donation apps; Salla Quick donation / التبرع السريع, product donation options)
note: Taking donations through the store.

capability: Inventory tracking: stock quantities (Shopify Inventory; Salla Inventory, Product Quantity / إدارة المخزون)
note: Parent of CM-INV-002 to CM-INV-004 (M-012).

capability: Inventory history: the log of stock changes (Shopify inventory history; Salla Inventory log / سجل كميات المنتجات)
note: Both keep it inside their inventory concerns.

capability: Inventory counts: stocktakes (Shopify inventory counts)
note: Shopify only so far; Shopify gates it by its own entitlement.

capability: Low-stock alerts (Salla product.quantity.low, product-quantity-notify)
note: Salla only so far.

capability: Inventory locations: locations, branches and warehouses (Shopify Locations; Salla Branches, Warehouses & branches / الفروع والمستودعات)
note: Where a store's stock is held. Joined on role (landings, notes). Parent of CM-INV-006.

capability: Inventory transfers between locations (Shopify Transfers and inventory shipments; Salla Inventory transfer)
note: Moving stock from one location to another. Parent of CM-INV-007.

capability: Purchase orders and suppliers (Shopify Purchase orders, suppliers)
note: Stock ordered from suppliers. Shopify only so far; its purchase-order permissions depend on its transfer permissions (notes).
